source.license: Publicly accessible for a fee; contractual

access.note: Per-document paid retrieval via a Verrechnungsstelle. No open bulk, no free API.

pagination.note: Request a company's Jahresabschluss by Firmenbuchnummer (+ year). No enumeration; no bulk. Figures via PDF parsing or an aggregator's structured API.

snapshot.note: Persist the filed document; parse figures (or consume a structured aggregator feed).

parsing.notes: Größenklasse (§221 UGB) governs which lines exist; Kleinst/klein file balance sheet only (no GuV) -> revenue/net_income null. Map Bilanzsumme->total_assets, Eigenkapital->equity, Umsatzerlöse->revenue, Jahresüberschuss/-fehlbetrag->net_income. EUR; AT locale.

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per Geschäftsjahr; map Bilanz + GuV.

fixture_requirements: große/mittel GmbH with full Bilanz + GuV (revenue present)
kleine/Kleinst company (abridged balance sheet only; revenue null)

live_test_plan.smoke: Not applicable without a paid contract — do not attempt unauthenticated retrieval.
live_test_plan.full: Behind FB_JAHRESABSCHLUSS_CLEARINGHOUSE_KEY, retrieve target companies' Jahresabschluss by Firmenbuchnummer; parse; normalize. For scale prefer a commercial aggregator's financial API.

blockers: Paid per document; no open bulk; no free API.
Small/micro companies file balance sheet only (no revenue/net_income).
Documents are PDF/structured filing — extraction required.
